assignments.brief_reason: Removal/approval is tied to factual support vs inflammatory/ill-informed content.
Explicitly says threats/personal attacks with profanity reduce acceptance.
Expletives are treated as a toxic cue that increases vitriol and drives removal.
Dislikes name-calling, which functions as a personal/toxic content bar.
Checks whether the stance suggests resorting to violence.
Keeps content that furthers conversation without personal derogation/being offensive.

Focuses on tolerating rudeness/accusations via debate-likeness rather than threats/toxicity removal criteria explicitly.
